gates.visible_change: Turnstile arms fold away and the mailroom entrance opens (2 cells wide).
gates.locked_hint: A sign by the turnstile: Reception clearance pending (finish the Lobby route).

gates.visible_change: The clock room's glass door slides aside; the room is walkable.
gates.locked_hint: The scheduling form is visible through the glass; the door waits for correct entries.

gates.visible_change: The east Records door slides open.
gates.locked_hint: RECORDS mat and door sign: Orientation seal required; the garden route home stays visible.

gates.visible_change: A flagstone path opens through the garden bed (south rim from the kit after state, north rim from the garden_north_rim_open gap), joining the south and north bands along column 12.

npcs.note: Reception lead. Waves at the arrival, takes his post, nods after the Lobby route, flashes his tablet while the scheduling form is broken, laughs after the Orientation seal.
Courier. Visible from the hub path near the Records door; moves into the mailroom after level 02; visits the right desk during level 05.

main.label: elevator, then the counter-clockwise garden loop along row 12 (right, up, left, down), then to Ivo
reception to the badge printer by the west and north bands
printer to the scheduling form wall at the clock room
clock room to the left desk
left desk to the right desk around the south band
right desk to the garden review table

backtrack.label: printer straight down the garden cut-through to reception
Records door back to the elevator by the north and west bands

spawns.when: new game, or elevator arrival from another district (elevator opens, avatar steps out)
return from a terminal scene at the reception

notes: Garden landmark footprint is x11-15, y7-10 (cell collision; offset 0). Its three lamps block (10,6) and (15,6) as in the kit; the first loop band is x8-9 / x17-18 / y4-5 / y12-13, so every loop cell has a free 2x2 block.
Counter-clockwise loop: right along row 12, up column 17, left along row 5, down column 9; the Pace floor arrows mark this 'approved route'.

wall_e_plain is omitted on the Records door rows (5-7) and wall_w_plain on the elevator rows (12-14) so the door and elevator entries govern collision. If their art does not cover the wall face there, the kit needs a frame piece (see NEEDS_ART.md).
